dag.description: Minimal XGBoost train-and-register pipeline: Cradle load -> tabular preprocessing -> XGBoost training -> MIMS Package/Payload -> Registration. No inline evaluation or calibration; the freshly trained model is packaged and registered directly.

agent_context.when_to_use: Regional XGBoost retraining/redeployment where model quality is validated out-of-band (or already qualified) and you only need to (re)train on fresh Cradle data, package, and register with MIMS. The fastest path from Cradle data to a registered, deployable XGBoost model; used by ucm_regional_xgboost.
agent_context.when_not_to_use: If you need inline evaluation metrics before registration (use xgboost_complete_e2e or xgboost_percentile_e2e). If you need score calibration (use a DAG with ModelCalibration/PercentileModelCalibration). If text/embedding features are involved (use a PyTorch or hybrid DAG).
differentiators: No calibration and no evaluation subgraph: train -> package -> register only
6 nodes / 6 edges, the minimal deployable XGBoost pipeline
XGBoostTraining fans out directly to both Package and Payload from a single training artifact

prerequisites.check: Tabular features + label available from Cradle
prerequisites.how: Cradle SQL returns numeric/categorical features and a label column
Team qualifies model quality separately, not inside this pipeline

common_pitfalls: No eval step means regressions are not caught in-pipeline; validate offline
Package and Payload both consume XGBoostTraining output; bundle the inference handler via Package inference_scripts_input
Registration input variable list must match the training feature schema
